lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill slits. The constellation exhibits roughly 5-6 horizontal rows of local maxima with higher spatial frequency in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a distinct grid-like pattern of high-luminance anchor nodes across the mid-to-posterior lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow gradient transition running horizontally across the visible torso.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: High-luminance blobs are visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, though they appear with lower contrast and smaller pixel diameter compared to the lateral flank constellation.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an elongated, low-luminance teleost (remora) visible in the water column immediately ventral to the shark's midsection.
